title: the Glass Steppe Rising Anew
author: August Zhou
blurb: Isandro Zhou, the keeper of a gate that should stay shut, keeps the ledgers of a guild that trades in impossible things. Then the crown announces a hunt for anyone with the gift — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, they must unbind a king from the thing wearing his crown before the usurper's armies reach the free cities.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
